t: Will the Fear Not Leave When the Journey Ends…
b:
(A song about bringing joy to strangers and giving freely, like rain from a passing cloud.)

These are from a song in the film 180, starring Siddharth and Nithya Menen. A film that drew me somehow. Nithya Menen alone is enough. But it is also a film in which I enjoyed Siddharth's acting a great deal.. Beyond all that, what drew me was the core of the story… a doctor struck by an incurable illness.. In his daily life, relationships and work, his death stands everywhere in the form of fear.. More than death, the fear of it, and the fear felt by those around him, put him under pressure many times over, and he decides to remake the rest of his life. Giving up his whole identity, like a newborn child of the earth, he journeys towards a happy life for 180 days

But wait.. if you ask whether this is possible for everyone.. no.. Shaking off every relationship and responsibility is impossible.. You need stability in everything, financially and psychologically.

But there was a time in my life too when I longed for those 180 days… I went to university to study and lost myself for six years… I was worn out in body and in mind.. I wasn't used to asking for help.. Nor was there anyone who gave without being asked.. An age when despair became my life.. When I stood helpless, having lost hope, having lost myself, a few good hearts held me up… otherwise I would have vanished then and there.. But that dark time gave me the desire to seek light… When the exams were over and many went off to work, my decision was: no, absolutely not.. Even when I wavered over it, it was my mother and my friends who said no

If you ask whether my decision was right… today my answer is yes… It may set me back in my career… I don't know… but without this rest, freedom and growth of mind, the time I live would have become hell.. Truly, I put my real life on hold and went looking for another, shadow life.. trusting that tomorrow this shadow would become real

Six years ago today I never imagined I would be friends with all these people.. Nor did they..In a life chased by death, I went chasing hearts.. And they held on to me tightly.. To me, who had been a frog in a well, the variety of the wide world became at least a little clear… or they made it clear

My foolishness in asking why only I had so much hardship… they made me realise it was nothing before their hardships and efforts.. My thoughts changed… my words changed.. A place to speak my innermost feelings openly; a group… where there are no judges.. only regular onlookers

They understood my feelings.. They were happy at my rise… If they hadn't forced me to get my licence, I wouldn't have it even today.. Even when I stood ready to give up halfway, saying I couldn't, how many chances they gave me to try, saying I could.. Some minutes spent on me in the middle of their own work

Those new relations who sensed I would break and tried to console me before it happened.. When even those I had known for so many years didn't understand it then, what they did was a wonder

I never had faith that my poems would one day become a book..But the dream came true… That day, when the book was released.. I was proud that I had so many people of my own.. That was God's doing

I thought that loneliness would surround me when I graduated..A thought that even among a thousand people I would be alone....Today, some relationships come looking for me, for my sake… Beautiful..

Today… the rest ends… work begins… reality has caught up with me… the fear peeps in that this journey may be ending… with faith that even if I let go they won't let go of me, and with gratitude

In the old body

a new me
note: 180 (2011) is a Tamil film starring Siddharth and Nithya Menen. A "frog in a well" is someone who knows only their own small world.
